home.description: I build backend services with Java and Spring Boot. My work in banking and e-commerce has covered customer onboarding, authentication, event-driven messaging, and warehouse systems.

highlights.onboarding: Led the design and implementation of digital time deposit onboarding with engineering teams in Indonesia and Singapore.
highlights.workerRecovery: Extended a PostgreSQL-backed worker framework with automatic retries and recovery for stalled onboarding tasks.

highlights.signingKeys: Implemented tenant-based JWT authentication and distributed verification keys through JWKS to support signing-key rotation.
highlights.messageIsolation: Separated time-sensitive one-time passwords from general notifications in a Kafka messaging platform.

highlights.modernization: Led the frontend modernization of the warehouse management system and designed a gradual migration from Vue 2 to Vue 3.
highlights.migration: Migrated production applications to Vue 3, upgraded a JSP application to Spring Boot 3, and mentored junior frontend engineers.
